sections.title: CONCLUSION
sections.text_preview: A new method for implementation of a power amplifier in a low-voltage CMOS process was presented. A novel fully integrated single-stage circular geometry active-transformer (DAT) power amplifier implemented in a low-voltage CMOS process achieves 1.9-W output power with 41% (31% single-ended) PAE at 2.4 GHz.
